OriginalEnglish: The city has been overrun by monsters<FG>
I have received similar tidings from Ingenia.
My people could not hold back the horde.
Lady Desdemona<FG>
Grave news from the Beastlands<FG>
The monsters of all three nations have risen up as one to overthrow their masters<FG>
The capitals of Klor, Kadava and Al-Khazam are now wholly under rebel control<FG>
A rebellion<FG><FH> These are grave tidings indeed...
Caw<FG> Just wait till I get my claws into them<FG>
It beggars belief...
How could they have risen up so swiftly<FH>
What the heck's going on here<FH>
Silence, all of you<FG>
Your Radiance...<FH>
The time has come...to make this fractured world whole once more<FG>
And we, the twins of prophecy, shall rule over all<FG>
No... It can't be...
What can't be<FH>
You'll think I'm mad for saying this, but...we weren't brought here to celebrate.
The High King brought us here to die.
What<FG><FH>
We have to get out of here, right now<FG>
This is the last place we've got to check, right<FH>
Coastline is clear. No single monster can be witnessed.
Yes.
Oh yeah<FG>
Alright, Accordia's ours<FG> Mission ac<MV>
<MV>compromised<FG>
Well, would you look at that.
The monsters saved the best for last.
What do you say, shall we make this fat lady sing<FH>
If that thing starts throwing its weight around, Accordia won't last five minutes<FG>
We won't let that happen.
Alright<FG> Let's show this thing who it's dealing with<FG>
Looks like we've finally got the job boxed off, so<FG>
People of Accordia<FG>
We have driven out the darkness...and taken back the city<FG>
So then, you two...
...Do you still have your doubts<FH>
Still question our decision to fight<FH>
Whether we are right to go against the word of the prophecy<FH>
Or could it be that you have your answer now<FH>
Yeah.
We have to fight. People are counting on us.
Settle down, everyone<FG>
I know we have a lot to cheer about, but this isn't over yet.
She's right about this not being over. There's one thing left to do.
Make that two.
And they're waiting for us...at the top of that tower<FG>
Pardon the intrusion.
My dear Desdemona...
What a surprise to see you.
By my reckoning, you and your companions should be long dead.
You obviously don't know who you're dealing with<FG>
And you'll find my friends here are no pushovers either<FG>
That's right, pops<FG>
You made a big mistake when you messed with us<FG>
Oh<FH>
Then I shall be certain to correct my error.
I do so detest loose ends...
Your Radiance<FG>
You're the Supreme Sovereign of the Seven Realms<FG>
The one who's supposed to keep the peace in our world<FG>
So why...<FH>
Why would you do this<FG><FH>
Why, you ask<FH>
To keep the very peace you hold so dear, of course.
What, by invading Dunisia<FH>
You send monsters to kill my people, and you call that ‘keeping the peace’<FG><FH>
...Allow us to explain, my young friend.
In order to rid the world of war, one must eliminate the source of conflict.
Which is to say, of course...
the species known as humankind.
Nonsense<FG>
Humans don't cause conflict<FG>
Ever since the War of Kings, we've heeded the word of the prophecy, and kept the peace for a thousand years<FG>
How can you possibly say that we're to blame<FG><FH>
Behold<FG>
Could this be...your fabled Cup of Kings<FH>
It is brimming with evil<FG>
The Cup overfloweth with man's doubt for his fellow man...with his hatred...with his violence<MV>yea, his every negative urge<FG>
It is wholly corrupted by darkness.
This once-hallowed chalice...now spills over with spite and despair...
Proof, if any were needed, of humanity's irredeemable depravity.
You were warned. You heard the prophecy and rushed headlong into war regardless.
In doing so, you revealed your true nature...and proved yourselves beyond salvation.
That is why, as the chosen twins of prophecy, we came to our decision<MV>
to purge this land of its human blight and create a new world, free of conflict.
Madness...
Do you honestly expect us to accept this<FG><FH>
You believe, because you are twinned, this makes you doubly correct<FH>
Foolish men<FG> You are quadruply false<FG>
All has come to pass just as the prophecy foretold.
The earth has been bathed in blood, and we have duly taken our place as the world's true rulers.
Our reign is preordained. Our will shall not be disobeyed.
We hereby decree...
That humankind, in its entirety, must be exterminated, once and for all<FG>
Look<FG>
They're<MV> I think they're absorbing the darkness from the Cup of Kings<FG>
Guess these guys mean business.
Luckily, we mean business too.
Whatever the prophecy says is going to happen...
I don't care.
It doesn't mean we can't fight it<FG>
We're going to beat you, and save our world<FG>
You can stick your prophecy where the sun don't shine<FG>
If you wish to fight destiny itself, you are welcome to try.
We shall be more than happy...to seal your fate<FG>
Ugh... Help...me...
Brother...<FH>
Why...<FG><FH>
H-Holy smoke<FG> I think he's snuffed it<FG>
To deprive the life of one's own blood and flesh...
It is too much shameful<FG>
My own flesh and blood<FH>
My only brother died a long time ago.
Over a thousand years, in fact...
A thousand years<FH>
What nonsense is this<FH>
It... It can't be<FG>
You lucky devils<FG>
It is rare indeed that I reveal my true face to mere humans.
Few of your kind have ever done enough to earn the privilege<FG>
My name is Fractos<FG>
From this day forth, you may consider me the Supreme Sovereign of this world.
Fractos...<FH>
Wait, that's... Isn't he the one who started the war a thousand years ago<FH> Surely not...
What the heck's going on here<FG><FH>
Why were you pretending to be the High King's twin brother<FH>
Since I'm in such a good mood,
I will grant you the explanation you so fervently desire.
I borrowed this old fool's form with one thing in mind<FI>
to corrupt the purpose of your precious prophecy.
To what end<FG><FH>
By posing as your pathetic ruler's twin brother,
I gained access to the highest office in the Seven Realms<FG>
Thus did I corrupt the Cup of Kings, and convince him to destroy his own people<FG>
Are you saying this was all your doing<FH>
Precisely.
And it was all so easy<FG>
In his heart of hearts, your High King was an unusually fatalistic creature.
I had but to coax out his true nature.
He was a very willing pawn in my game...but one which has served its purpose.
The Seven Realms have been plunged into chaos, and the Cup of Kings overflows with the darkness of men's hearts...
All is as it was a thousand years ago<FG>
I have only to use the power of the Cup of Kings to awaken my true strength,
and I shall become a being more terrible than the very gods themselves<FG>
Not if I have anything to do with it<FG>
Ohhh<FH> Now that looks familiar.
It would seem that you and I are related, my dear.
I would have hoped for a little more respect...from my own blood<FG>
Why would I ever respect you<FH>
You're a stain on my family's name<MV>one that I mean to erase<FG>
All of my training has been for this one purpose<FG>
And now...you will die<FG>
Can it really be true<FH> Has a thousand years of monotony turned those of my bloodline into mewling moralists<FH>
Consider yourself disowned.
Desdemona<FG>
You'll pay for that...
Oh, my dear little prince.
When you grit your teeth like that, you look just like your father.
What<FG><FH>
Allow me to confess.
It was I who gave the Sword of Discord to the King of Al<F6>Khazam.
It was I who told the prophecy to the Queen of Ingenia.
And yes...it was I who slipped into your father's chamber...
and thrust a knife in his back<FG>
Cesar<FG>
Lest there be any lingering doubt, my dear humans, you are powerless to stop me.
You see...now that the Cup of Kings lies in my grasp, my might knows no equal in this world or the next<FG>
Well, I have greatly enjoyed our little talk.
But it is time you accepted your fate.
Behold the darkness and despair<FG>
There has to be another way...
I only wish there were.
But you know what would happen if anyone learnt the truth.
Even if we kept them locked away, he'd be sure to find them sooner or later.
I know it's hard, but we have to split them up.
Alright. If you promise me it will keep them safe...
Don't worry.
When the time comes...
What happened<FH>
Where's everyone gone<FH>
Desdemona<FG>
Thank goodness<FG> I thought you were a goner<FG>
Hey<FG>
What d'you think you're doing<FG><FH>
Seriously<FG> What's got into you<FG><FH>
There has to be another way...
I only wish there were.
But you know what would happen if anyone learnt the truth.
Even if we kept them locked away, he'd be sure to find them sooner or later.
I know it's hard, but we have to split them up.
Alright. If you promise me it will keep them safe...
Don't worry.
When the time comes...
I'm back...
But where's everyone else<FH>
Desdemona<FG>
Thank goodness<FG> You're okay<FG>
Wh<MV><FG><FH> Hey<FG>
What was that for<FG><FH>
Stay back<FG> I'm warning you<FG>
Why are you doing this<FG><FH>
I don't want to fight you<FG> We're all friends here, remember<FH>
And I didn't have anything to do with starting the war, y<MV>
I know it's hard, but we have to split them up.
Alright. If you promise me it will keep them safe...
Don't worry.
When the time comes...they'll remember who they are.
Of course... Now I understand...
We're not cousins, are we<FH>
We're twins<FG>
Hear me, children of Unos<FG>
Your time has come.
Arise, and embrace your true power<FG>
Wake up<FG>
Please, wake up<FG>
They're awake<FG>
Look, look<FG> Their eyes are open and everything<FG>
Praises be<FG>
You are not expired<FG>
Though we shook and shouted you, you did not arouse.
We have been most perturbed...
Ah...we're back.
I thought I'd never see you again<FG>
Don't cry, Healix.
We're not going anywhere.
So, uh...what exactly happened to us back there<FH>
Fractos hit us with the lightning, and then...
Sorry, lad...but that's as much as any of us remembers.
We woke up down here, with no Pinnacle o' Peace left up there...
Guess someone was lookin' out for us, huh<FH>
Got us outta there before the whole place came crumblin' down.
Don't know who, though. Your guess is as good as mine.
But there's one thing we do remember<FG>
Right, everyone<FH>
The truth is...while we were unconscious...it seems we all had the same dream.
A dream...<FH>
It was about you.
We dreamt that you were twins<MV>twins descended from High King Unos himself.
This is no ordinary wind<FG>
What is wrong with the weather in this world<FG><FH>
First we get struck by lightning, and now we're caught in a hurricane<FG>
L-Look<FG>
Why...<FH>
Why are you doing this<FG><FH>
I don't want to fight with any of you<FG>
I've only ever fought to protect the people I care ab<MV>
I know it's hard, but we have to split them up.
